name: Triund
title: The Panoramic Ridge of Dhauladhar
description: A breathtaking trekking destination near McLeod Ganj, offering stunning views of the Dhauladhar mountain range, lush meadows, and unforgettable sunrises.

name: Auli
title: India's Snow Paradise
description: A famous Himalayan hill station known for snow-covered peaks, skiing adventures, ropeway rides, and spectacular views of Nanda Devi.

name: Munnar View Point
title: Rolling Tea Hills and Misty Peaks
description: One of Kerala's most scenic viewpoints, surrounded by endless tea gardens, cool weather, winding roads, and breathtaking sunrise views.

name: Pelling
title: Gateway to Mount Kanchenjunga
description: A peaceful hill town in Sikkim famous for crystal-clear views of Mount Kanchenjunga, monasteries, waterfalls, and skywalk adventures.

name: Laitlum Canyon
title: The Endless Valley Viewpoint
description: A hidden gem in Meghalaya offering dramatic cliffs, deep valleys, floating clouds, and one of the most mesmerizing panoramic views in Northeast India.

name: Kasol
title: The Mini Israel of India
description: Nestled along the Parvati River, Kasol is famous for pine forests, mountain cafés, trekking routes, and breathtaking Himalayan landscapes.

name: Chopta
title: The Mini Switzerland of Uttarakhand
description: A beautiful alpine destination surrounded by dense forests and snow-capped Himalayan peaks, serving as the base for the Tungnath trek.

name: Mount Abu Sunset Point
title: The Best Sunset View of Rajasthan
description: A spectacular viewpoint overlooking the Aravalli Hills, famous for colorful sunsets, cool climate, and panoramic valley scenery.
